entries.title: That sounds like mockery to me
entries.odia: କଥା କହୁଥାଏ କେଉଁ ରସରେ, ମୋତେ ଲାଗୁଥାଏ ପରିହାସରେ
entries.literal_meaning: Whatever the manner of the speech, it feels like mockery to me.
entries.explanation: A listener hears ridicule, whatever the speaker intended. The contrast draws attention to how words are received.
entries.meaning_odia: କହୁଥିବା ଲୋକର ଭାବ ଯାହା ହେଉ, ଶୁଣୁଥିବା ଲୋକକୁ କଥାଟି ପରିହାସ ପରି ଲାଗୁଛି।
entries.usage_example: A playful remark lands badly with someone already upset. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary gives this under manner and a related wording under intention. No particular speaker or quarrel is identified.

entries.title: Time slips away
entries.odia: ମାରି ମାରି ଗଲା କାଳକ ଆଉ ରହିଗଲା ଫାଳକ
entries.literal_meaning: Whiling it away, time has gone; a half remains.
entries.explanation: Time has passed while one was merely getting through it. The remaining half is a rhyming image, not a measured lifespan.
entries.meaning_odia: ଏମିତି ସମୟ କାଟୁକାଟୁ ବେଳ ଚାଲିଗଲାଣି; ଯାହା ବାକି ଅଛି ତାହାର କଥା ମନେ ପଡ଼ୁଛି।
entries.usage_example: After postponing a task repeatedly, someone notices how much of the available time has passed. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary places this under whiling away time. It does not establish the speaker’s age.

entries.title: A threat against someone’s food
entries.literal_meaning: I will hurt you through your rice, not with my hand.
entries.explanation: The threat is to deprive someone of food or support rather than strike them. It exposes another form of coercion.
entries.meaning_odia: ହାତ ଉଠାଇବା ବଦଳରେ ଖାଇବା ବା ଚଳିବାର ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ବନ୍ଦ କରି କଷ୍ଟ ଦେବାର ଧମକ ଏହା।
entries.usage_example: Someone withholds promised support to punish disagreement; another person identifies the threat. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: Recorded as a saying, not advice or justification for deprivation.
